reason: The cited evidence does not directly support the key premises for a Cr–Al coating on Zr-alloy. E1 and E2 concern Cu–Si interdiffusion in multi-element thin-film barriers, not Cr–Zr interdiffusion or oxidation behaviour. E3 and E4 address AlNbTiZr medium-entropy alloy coatings on Zr-alloy, showing improved corrosion resistance with a specific Al content, but do not demonstrate Cr–Al oxide formation or its role as a diffusion barrier. The mechanism of enhanced diffusion resistance from multi-element alloys is cited from a different material system and is not linked to the proposed Cr–Al system.
